diagnose.name: 🔧 Connection Diagnostics
diagnose.prompt:
Please diagnose connection failure, black screen, or network issues. Inspect the last 200 lines of /data/local/tmp/cloudphone-agent.log focusing on:
1. Launch parameters and NAT mappings
2. Network environment and ICE candidates
3. WebRTC and UDS 3-channel connectivity
4. CoreService and keyframe status
Provide a detailed diagnosis and actionable recommendations.
